"""Post-inference pipeline: discovery certificate, calibration, deployment."""
from offline_discovery.rule_generate import build_clusters, extract_fragments
from offline_discovery.rule_remove import calibrate, exact_bank_entries
from online_matching.match_p4 import IntervalAutomaton
from online_matching.train_rf import (backup_predict, train_backup,
                                      training_matrix, tree_certificate)
from sessions import SessionEngine

def _priority_key(cluster):
    return (-cluster['score'], cluster['id'])


def build_release(spec, fragments, capacity):
    """Full certificate item plus the runtime model used by the replay."""
    width = spec['width']
    classes = spec['classes']
    clusters, noise = build_clusters(fragments, spec['eps'], spec['ratio'])
    for index, cluster in enumerate(clusters):
        cluster['index'] = index
    calibration = IntervalAutomaton([
        (index, cluster['class'], len(cluster['range']), cluster['range'])
        for index, cluster in enumerate(clusters)])
    calibrate(clusters, spec['validation'], spec['threshold'], classes, calibration)
    del calibration
    kept = sorted((cluster for cluster in clusters if cluster['kept']),
                  key=_priority_key)
    priority = [cluster['id'] for cluster in kept]
    automaton = IntervalAutomaton([
        (cluster['id'], cluster['class'], len(cluster['range']), cluster['range'])
        for cluster in kept])
    features, labels = training_matrix(spec['train'], width)
    nodes = tree_certificate(train_backup(features, labels))
    if spec['mode'] == 'range':
        entries = len(kept)
